title: Biology Laboratory Manual: Introduction to Molecular, Cellular, and Physiological Principles
description: This lab manual is designed for students enrolled in the second lab course in the introductory biology sequence at Iowa State University. It is a semester-long lab course, required by most life-science-related majors at ISU, and includes activities on the scientific method, molecular and cellular biology, energetics, genetics, plant anatomy and physiology, and animal anatomy and physiology.
authors: Carly Manz - Author / Chanda Skelton - Author
